# chameleon_namespace (Data Source)

Fetch details of an existing Chameleon namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_namespace" "raw" {
  catalog = "analytics"
  name    = "raw"
}

output "raw_namespace_properties" {
  value = data.chameleon_namespace.raw.properties
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String)
- `name` (String) Dot-separated namespace path.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `properties` (Map of String)
